goal: Close the gap between the implemented kernels and the perf model's achievable time for Kimi K3.1 on VR200: NVFP4 checkpoint (NVFP4 W4A4 routed experts, MXFP8 shared experts + KDA projections), DEP16 prefill, DCP4 x DP8 EP32 decode. Every kernel family gets an owner, a measured gap analysis and a target of at most 1.1x model achievable.

findings.text: Topology is not the lever: best unbuilt decode layouts project only +2-5% over DCP4 x DP8 EP32; the step is 2.1-2.3x model achievable, all of it kernel time.
NVFP4 near-term (enablement only) projects prefill 19.4-20.5K and decode r8 1.2-1.45K; the rest of the gap to 30.7K / 2.9K is kernel efficiency.
Largest decode gaps (r24, EP16-transferred): BF16 GEMMs 4.2 ms, MegaMoE ~3.4, DCP top-k 2.0, DSA attention 1.7, KDA 1.6, small ops 1.2.

Pool: no Rhea GPU hold has started yet (6 x 1-node + 1 x 8-node pending; cluster full, first start est ~13:50 PST, 8-node ~03:20). 22 GPU requests are waiting; agents are writing kernels and tests meanwhile.

INFRA: the earlier 1-node decode slice had all 224 local experts touched per GPU (sdec reads moe.gate.weight, so balanced routing never applied): its MoE row is 8x the EP32 expert traffic; MegaMoE must come from the new emulation.
HW: Rubin double-K block-scaled MMA forms only exist in sm_107a builds; sm_100f-family builds run at half the block-scaled rate. Every FP8/FP4 kernel must be checked for the native form.
P-MOE: NVFP4 EP16 8K MegaMoE is NVLink-bound on the BF16 combine (~75% of tensor time idle), so the MXFP8 shared experts can hide under it.
D-ATTN: LocalQuery implemented (compute all 96 q heads locally under SP instead of publishing FP8 q to peers); unit test + bench queued.

Policy (user): die-local placement is mandatory wherever the model assumes die-local bandwidth (expert weights; optionally dense weights, KDA state, KV/keys). Kernels are held to the die-local model number; HW agent writing the localization how-to first.

Policy (user): target the practical speed of light, not marginal gains. Each workstream must state its hardware-limited design (bound resource, minimum kernels/passes, fusion/overlap/localization) and build that design; progress is reported as gap closed toward model achievable.
D-FUSE: fused AttnRes + SP all-gather/reduce-scatter chain measured on 4 GPUs: r24 2.02 -> 1.53 ms/step vs model 1.43 (1.07x), r8 0.98 vs 0.84; bit-exact. First family near target.
D-TOPK: in-tree DCP top-k measured 30/45/86 us per layer at r1/r8/r24 vs model 6/7/9; ties straddle ranks on 98% of rows; pre-pass sized for 1M context. SOL redesign in progress (first tie fix -11%).
D-MOE: FI a368c5f66 NVFP4 at the EP32 per-GPU shape (28 experts, 1 GPU): 34.7-52 us/layer T1-T128; EP32 adds ~17 us comm on Hecate. Vendored into kimi_k3 byte-identical.

D-GEMM: best existing kernels stream 3-7.5 TB/s; NVFP4 dense family projects 6.7 ms vs model 2.8 ms at r24. MXFP8 SP path (B4) landed-ready, tests pass. SOL design (die-local, swap-AB persistent) next.

P-MLA: random 576 B KV-row gather saturates at ~18 TB/s from L2 on VR200 (LDG = TMA gather4), so sparse MLA prefill floor is ~1.07 ms/layer at F16K vs model 0.64: model omits re-gather bytes (model fix candidate).

HW: 1-CTA MMA with both operands in SMEM is capped at 2/3 of Rubin double-K peak; A in TMEM or 2-CTA reaches full rate. Multi-peer system-scope release stores serialize on NVLink round trips; multicast release is ~3x faster.
EN: NVFP4 MegaMoE loading landed-ready (6f164db270), 145 unit tests pass on VR200. No EP32 NVFP4 knob records yet.
Blockers: only 2 Rhea nodes running (16 GPU requests waiting; next holds est 14:25); ncu/nsys are not in the image, so root causes rely on probes.

Rule (user): baseline and target are the NVFP4 checkpoint only; MXFP4 numbers are removed from the tracker. Gap closed is shown only for workstreams whose baseline, current and achievable are all NVFP4-basis (ckpt=nvfp4). NVFP4 in-step baselines (decode slice r8/16/24, DEP16 slice) are INFRA's top priority.
First NVFP4 number: 1-node DEP16 slice (L24 view) F16K forward 211.3 ms vs NVFP4 model 165 ms (1.28x); 23 MegaMoE NVFP4 + 82 MXFP8 linears confirmed in the log. Profiled per-family baseline next.

P-MOE: prefill MegaMoE at the EP4 emulation is NOT link-bound (all-local routing only 1% faster); the FC1/FC2 epilogue (TMEM load, SiTU, NVFP4 requant, one epilogue warp per sub-partition) bounds it, tensor pipe ~26% active. SOL redesign target: epilogue throughput.

P-GEMM: prefill GEMMs themselves are 0.94-1.07x model (router, w_uk bmm, f_b_proj, dense down are 1.25-1.54x); the family excess is glue: MXFP8 activation-quant producers run at 3.2x their HBM floor (one 16 B load in flight per thread).
P-IDX: stock prefill indexer 2.22 ms/layer (logits 1.56 + top-k 0.65); the model prices the logits epilogue as FP32 SIMT but stock is packed BF16, so the model over-prices it (model fix).

D-MOE: decode MegaMoE NVFP4 at the EP32 per-GPU shape streams weights at 85-90% of die-local HBM; the overhead is fixed: router/stage front ~3 us, CTA-end imbalance ~4 us, tail barrier ~1.2 us, separate reduce ~3 us per layer.

NVFP4 PREFILL BASELINE (profiled 1-node DEP16 slice): 218.7 ms vs 164.5 achievable (1.33x). Excess by family: KDA core +17.4 ms (4.8x), sparse MLA +8.4 (3.2x), router/latent/top-k +8.2 (1.7x), indexer +6.9 (1.8x), preview drafter +3.0, KDA MXFP8 proj +1.9, DSA proj +1.3, shared +1.0; MegaMoE NVFP4 74.0 vs 73.3 (1.01x at the EP4 emulation). Prefill owners re-based on it.

P-GEMM: the transcendental glue dominates prefill GEMM-family excess: shared SiTU+MXFP8 quant 116 us/layer (floor 36; precise tanhf, MUFU-bound) and router top-k 43 us (floor 4; precise sigmoid). The model prices both as free.
D-TOPK: topk_v2 (one CTA per row, one NVLink round with a band of global ids) is bitwise equal to the old merge and resolves ties in round 1 on 100% of rows; timing in progress.
Pool: 11 Rhea nodes running (backfill), 0 runs waiting; daemon now also keeps 6 non-preemptible batch holds queued. Rhea ssh dropped once (re-authenticated 14:45).

D-TOPK: topk_v2 (exact, bitwise vs old merge) 27/27/34 us per layer at r1/r8/r24, down from 30/45/86 (model 6/7/9.4): r24 gap 76.3 -> 24.8 us/layer above model. Remaining: in-kernel candidate pass 3x slower than standalone, chains of synced small steps.

D-MOE: re-vendored FI a368c5f66 MegaMoE backend (die-local, shared expert on side stream) landed-ready; 1-node decode slice step -7/-13/-16% at r8/16/24 (measured on the MXFP4 view; NVFP4 decode re-measure pending). INFRA trial merge breaks EN megamoe tests (manifest/vendored sources): being reconciled.
D-FUSE in-step: fused AttnRes+SP chain exposed 576 -> 417 us/step at r24 L24 (model 365); multicast final gather replaces NCCL ring AG.
P-KDA: fused o_norm + MXFP8 quant at HBM rate 145 vs 203 us/layer (F16K); conv fusion into K1 is bitwise but slower until K1 becomes persistent multi-tile.

P-IDX: fused indexer v1 (2x-K MXF4 MMA): MMA + TMA 0.58 ms/layer, + stock-precision BF16 epilogue 1.38 ms (logits bitwise equal to DeepGEMM 1.56 ms); exact streaming select still +4-5 ms, being redesigned.
Tooling: the image has no ncu, nsys or nvdisasm (SASS/stall reasons not inspectable). Request to the user pending: download Nsight Compute/Systems to Lustre.
P-KDA landed-ready: HBM-rate o_norm + MXFP8 quant kernel, KDA chain 77.2 -> 72.7 ms per F16K forward (model 17.4). Next: persistent multi-tile K1 with fused conv, tcgen05 K2.
D-MOE: decode workspace capacity 128 tokens (N128 tile) is 10% faster than the 256-token bucket at T32-T128 on the EP32 per-GPU shape; EP28/EP32 decode bucket record added.
P-MOE: prefill MegaMoE time is linear in live rows (~130 us per 1K rows + ~60 us fixed at 56 experts/GPU).

Coordination: 9 of 14 agents ended after their first milestone, short of target; relaunched as continuation agents that keep going until their family is at 1.1x model (plus FAST). 13 Rhea nodes running, nothing waiting.

Controlled same-node A/B (prefill DEP16 slice): NVFP4 is 1.31-1.34x faster than the MXFP4 checkpoint (not 1.75x). 95% of the saving is KDA projections + shared experts going BF16 -> MXFP8 (3x tensor rate on VR200). MegaMoE is unchanged: at prefill (>512 tok/rank) the MXFP4 checkpoint already runs the NVFP4 W4A4 kernel. Model fixes needed: MXFP4 prefill MegaMoE rows, and MoE comm added serially at EP16 volume (perf-model/microbench/results/prefill_nvfp4_vs_mxfp4).

NVFP4 DECODE BASELINE (1-node D3-32 DP-rank slice, L24): step r8/r16/r24 6.67/8.91/10.89 ms vs achievable 2.68/3.24/3.80 (2.5-2.9x); target-only (preview drafter removed) 4.91/6.00/6.77 vs 2.41/2.89/3.53 (~2x). r24 excess: drafter (preview artifact) 3.8, GEMMs 0.76, top-k 0.59, MegaMoE 0.44, DSA attention 0.55, KDA 0.43, small ops 0.43, SP comm 0.18 ms.

Integration branch wzhao/k31ws-int e4514e51af = D-GEMM + EN + D-MOE + P-MOE: NVFP4 prefill slice F16K 218.7 -> 199.8 ms (P-MOE 8K sub-calls -6.5%); MegaMoE prefill now measures 0.77x the model (model MoE comm/fc rows look pessimistic: model fix pending, real EP16 4-node check needed).
D-FUSE on NVFP4: step r24 -2.8% (6841 -> 6651 us L24); AttnRes + SP AG/RS at 1.10x model: at target. Landed-ready.

NVFP4 ACCURACY RISK (EN): with the export unit input scales, the FC2-input NVFP4 requant (routing weight applied before it) loses range for small activations (rel error 0.26 at RMS 2^-8, 15% blocks zeroed). Stock path has the same math; a power-of-two fc1 norm constant fixes it exactly. Needs real activation stats + gsm8k: real checkpoint download needs user approval.
P-MOE: in the prefill MegaMoE main kernel, the SiTU transcendentals cost ~170 us of 1055 us per 8K launch (no-transcendental probe 888 us); cheaper exact-equivalent SiTU forms are being evaluated.
D-TOPK in-step on NVFP4 slice: top-k family 106 -> 49 us/layer at r24 (57 -> 37 at r8), step -0.33 ms at r24; exact; landed-ready. Still 8x model.
P-MOE S3 (cheaper exact SiTU in the MegaMoE epilogue) in-step NVFP4: MegaMoE 56.6 -> 52.3 ms at F16K; the MMA warp waits 46% of its loop for accumulator stages (epilogue-bound).

P-MLA: keys-on-M kernel decomposition at F16K: full 2.85 ms vs tensor-only 1.09 ms (matches the SS operand-fetch model): softmax sits on the tensor critical path and the per-token epilogue does scattered 2-byte stores. Next: overlap softmax with MMA, TMEM-A operand.
D-GEMM: raw tcgen05/TMA stream-K GEMM prototype is correct but still 1.1-1.4x cuBLAS at small shapes after 2 CTAs/SM; L2 split reduce cost grows with contributors.
HW: HBM writes hit the same ceiling for any placement; in-place read+write state updates gain ~1.22x from die-local placement; batch several tcgen05.ld before one wait (~1.35x).
8-node: original hold8 72524 lost its start estimate; added a backfill 8-node request (est 18:18 today) and a batch one (est 05:31).

FULL-TOPOLOGY NVFP4 BASELINES (int 5718ef2d89): decode D3-32 on 8 nodes real EP32 r8/r16/r24 19.10/24.86/29.75 ms vs 9.50/11.46/13.50 (2.0-2.2x); prefill DEP16 on 4 nodes real EP16 790.3 ms F16K = 20.7K tok/s/GPU vs 628.2 per-op achievable (1.26x). Biggest decode gaps (r24): GEMMs 5.74 vs 2.93, MegaMoE 6.55 vs 5.27, KDA 3.43 vs 1.81, DSA attention 2.68 vs 1.00, top-k 2.55 vs 0.23, small ops 2.02 vs 0.15. Biggest prefill gaps: KDA 79.8 vs 17.4, router/latent 80.5 vs 48.0, indexer 61.6 vs 33.8, sparse MLA 49.2 vs 15.4; MegaMoE 261.5 vs 293.3 (below model: model fix).

HW (measured): die-local HBM read 18.4 TB/s (model 17.1, 7% conservative), default 12.75, remote 7.0; 1-CTA SS MMA capped at 2/3 double-K peak (TMEM-A or 2-CTA reaches full); counted TMA stores rejected by CUDA 13.4 ptxas (use multicast store / bulk multicast); 4-GPU flag round 10.9 us chained vs 3.3 us multicast.
FAST: step-bench iteration cut 247 s -> ~85 s (persistent Lustre JIT caches, fixed overlay mount, model-registry cache thrash fixed, CPU-side pre-check before taking GPUs).
D-MOE landed-ready 4b58015c31 (reconciled with EN, 157 megamoe tests pass): decode MegaMoE exposed ~1.5-1.6 ms per 23 layers on the die-split slice.

D-ATTN: LocalQuery in-step on NVFP4 slice brings the DSA attention family 0.91 -> 0.62 ms (model 0.36), but INFRA blocked the merge: test_sp_dsa_block_matches_stock_layer fails at R68 (q codes). Native sparse MLA decode v1 is exact but 49.5 vs 40.6 us (trtllm-gen) at R384.

P-KDA model note: the prefill KDA recurrence is latency-bound per 16-token step (stock 1.16 us, tcgen05 floor ~0.85 us), so the core floor is ~290 us/layer, not the model 167 us (bytes/BW). Model fix candidate.
P-IDX: stock-precision idx_score hardware floor 0.66 ms/layer at full issue (model prices an FP32 epilogue at 1.21 ms: model over-prices).
P-MLA: hybrid-orientation sparse MLA kernel (QK heads-on-M with Q in TMEM, PV keys-on-M, 576 TMEM cols) is correct; timing in progress.
FAST before/after (whole pool): model init median 864 s -> 0.3-2.4 s (cache thrash fixed); failed GPU-minutes 41% -> 15% (CPU pre-check); engine init 51-62 s -> 6-10 s; warm step bench 247 -> 85 s.

Release drafter: config-only view is enough for dummy-weight benches, but the release DSpark checkpoint (e4e6e626) is only on Hecate; until it is copied, decode is judged on target-only numbers (preview drafter tail ~4 ms is an artifact).

P-MLA: random KV-row gather reaches 20.6 TB/s with 16 gather4 warps and hoisted slot loads (new floor 0.94 ms/layer at F16K); concurrent tensor-core operand reads slow it, which shapes the sparse MLA prefill design.
P-GEMM attribution: prefill MOE glue per layer = shared SiTU + MXFP8 act quant 160 us + FI quant 40 us + latent RMSNorm 29 us; router top-k 65 us (latency-bound, 1 token per 128 threads).

D-FUSE: MXFP8 SP boundaries (KDA all-gather published as MXFP8, shared gate_up input written as MXFP8 by the fused kernels) remove separate act_quant kernels; family 0.79 -> 0.65 ms on the NVFP4 slice (model 0.37).
P-GEMM in-step NVFP4: family 83.9 -> 83.4 ms (target 80.0); router top-k 65 -> 29 us/layer; separate FI MXFP8 quant passes removed.

8-node D3-32 run on a new overlay died at startup: CUDA symmetric-memory rendezvous timed out (1800 s) while 32 ranks cold-compiled CuTe kernels. Fix: pre-warm the overlay compile caches on 1 node before every multi-node run.

INT 95f48ac5b4 (+D-MOE, P-MOE, D-FUSE): NVFP4 slices decode r8/r16/r24 6.19/8.23/10.01 ms (baseline 6.67/8.91/10.89), prefill F16K 197.8 ms (baseline 218.7). Model achievable now uses a fused MegaMoE row: decode 2.40/2.86/3.34, prefill 140.6. Graph-vs-eager rms on the NVFP4 slice rose to 6.4e-2 after D-FUSE: D-FUSE must prove it benign.
D-FUSE: its own kernels are at the measured floor (boundary pair ~1.07x); the rest of its family gap sits in neighbours (KDA o_proj act_quant, latent RMSNorm in MegaMoE reduce, o-proj epilogue push).
